data.body:
[P2] Preserve changes requests applied after the triggering event

A delayed or rerun `ready_for_review` job can execute after a maintainer applies `changes-requested`. Because `main()` fetches current labels but supplies only the original action and sender, this branch removes that newer request even though the author has made no subsequent update. Replaying an older qualifying `synchronize` event has the same problem. Pass event-ordering metadata into the script and verify that the latest `changes-requested` label application predates the triggering event before removing it, using the issue timeline. Add a regression test for a label applied after the event.
